persistence.basis: weekly snapshots over the trailing 3 years; the same strength board recomputed 28 calendar days later

methodology.construction: For each window (7/21/45/90 calendar days), a sector's return is its derived index's close-to-close return from the last close on or before (asof - days). Relative strength = sector return - NEPSE return over the same window. Strength score = the relative strength min-max normalised across the board's 11 sectors (weakest 0, strongest 100).
methodology.risk: volatility_long = population stdev of the sector index's daily % returns over the trailing 60 sessions. risk_score = 100 x (1 - volatility / the board's maximum volatility) — calmer sectors score higher. risk_level bands volatility: Low < 1.5, Moderate < 2.5, High above (our banding, stated).
methodology.overall: overall_score = 0.7 x mean of the four strength scores + 0.3 x risk_score. Sectors are ranked by overall score.
methodology.phase: trend_phase is the quadrant of (90d relative strength sign, 7d strength score >= 50): Leading / Weakening / Improving / Lagging.
methodology.labels: momentum_labels band the window's own return: >= +5 Strong Bullish, >= +1 Mild Bullish, between -1 and +1 Flat, <= -1 Mild Bearish, <= -5 Strong Bearish.
methodology.sector_basis: Sector indices are equal-weight composites of current constituents (the site's derived sector series), not official cap-weighted sub-indices; our taxonomy has 11 sectors with Trading inside Others and Hotels And Tourism as its own sector.
methodology.persistence: Measured history, not a forecast: weekly snapshots over the trailing three years, each board recomputed 28 calendar days later.
